name: spirit-crossing-launch-november-16
lines:
لعبة أونلاين هادئة
تبني فيها بيتك مع أصدقائك

تتجول وتصطاد السمك
وترسم الجداريات مع الجيران
headline:
لعبة Spirit Crossing
تصدر غدًا الاثنين
label: رسمي

angle.hook: Spirit Crossing, Spry Fox's cozy online game five years in the making, launches tomorrow on Switch 2, Switch and PC
angle.why_now: launch is Monday 16 Nov 2026, the day after the slot; the studio posted its roadmap through summer 2027 on 12 Nov
angle.what_it_means_here: Switch and Switch 2 pre-orders are open and the PC version is on Steam and Epic; no price on the pages read, Arabic support not listed in the pages read (Steam languages list has no Arabic)
angle.payoff: building a home, fishing tournaments, murals and shared spaces with friends, with demo progress carried into the full game

reel_check.SOURCE: not already posted: yes: ledger find spirit crossing and spry fox, 0 hits in newsroom/stories and cards
reel_check.SOURCE: age: yes: first report 28 Oct but the launch is the next day (16 Nov), reconfirmed by Steam 9 and 12 Nov; a launch-eve story, not a rewrite
reel_check.ANGLE before lines: yes: angle in the story file
reel_check.STORY TYPE release: yes: what it is, platforms, date; price and Arabic support stated as not given on the pages read, not claimed
reel_check.STORY: spoken paragraph, subject before: yes: headline names Spirit Crossing, line 1 says it is a cozy online game, line 2 says فيها; no line opens on و
reel_check.STORY: release verbs: yes: تصدر with the date, no bare تصل
reel_check.STORY: names match names-ar.md: yes: Spry Fox سبراي فوكس with the Latin in brackets in the credit; row added to names-ar.md
reel_check.POST: Arabic passes: yes: arabic-games-film-editor and arabic-writing loaded fresh, glossary read; DeepL whole-story forward pass and phrase alternatives (تُطلق vs تصدر kept ours; الودية vs هادئة kept ours; الانتقال الفوري taken)
